profile.headline: Front-End Developer @ WhatConverts
profile.summary:
Front-End Developer with a passion for creating responsive, accessible, and user-friendly websites using JavaScript/TypeScript, React (Next.js/Astro), and WordPress.

After starting my career in technical theatre, I retrained in modern web development, built a portfolio, and now work with clients nationwide to deliver high-quality, performance-optimized solutions. I'm always learning, and eager to keep improving.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain responsive website features using PHP, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML within a fast-paced SaaS environment.
- Manage website performance updates, technical SEO improvements, redirects, and ongoing site optimization initiatives.
- Implement and maintain cookie consent and compliance software to support privacy standards and user experience.
- Create, update, and optimize marketing email templates aligned with brand standards and campaign goals.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing and product teams to support lead generation, conversion tracking, and digital marketing initiatives.
- Troubleshoot frontend issues, improve site functionality, and ensure consistent performance across devices and browsers.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained responsive websites and landing pages using JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS, ensuring optimal user experience and accessibility.
- Collaborated with designers in Agile sprints to translate Adobe XD mockups into client-ready UI deliverables, balancing aesthetics with functionality.
- Developed custom themes and templates within content management systems (CMS).
- Implemented Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager to track user behavior, improve conversion rates, and optimize campaign performance.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed custom marketing websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and WordPress.
- Maintained and optimized performance for 30+ client commercial websites (B2B/B2C).  
- Overhauled dozens of client websites front-end structure, improving layout and accessibility, leading to a significant boost in Lighthouse audit scores.

educations.schoolName: Virginia Commonwealth University School of the Arts
